Fall schedule in effect from August 31st! 

We’re excited to announce an important change to our BBC Special Training schedule designed to give our students more flexibility and better training opportunities.

Previously, Sparring, Weapons, and other special training classes were assigned to specific days of the week. We found that this could be difficult for families—if a student was consistently unavailable on a particular day, they could miss that type of training altogether.

With our new schedule, we plan to move toward a Weekly Theme Training System for our Black Belt Club, Leadership Club, Master Club, and other memberships that include Special Training.

For example, the rotation may look like:
Week 1 – Sparring
Week 2 – Weapons & Tumbling
Week 3 – Sparring
Week 4 – Weapons & Self-Defense

Then the rotation continues with different combinations of Weapons, Tumbling, Self-Defense, and other Special Training. One thing will remain consistent: Sparring will be trained at least once every two weeks.

This new system means students will no longer have to rely on being available on one specific day to receive a particular type of training. Families will have more flexibility in choosing class days while students continue developing a broad range of Taekwondo skills.

Thank you, as always, for supporting your children and their continued growth at UBBA.
